sentences.text: Black Widow -LRB- Чёрная вдова , transliterated Chyornaya Vdova -RRB- -LRB- Natalia Alianovna `` Natasha '' Romanova , Russian : Наталья Альяновна '' Наташа '' Романова , also known as Natasha Romanoff -RRB- is a fictional superhero appearing in American comic books published by Marvel Comics .	Marvel Comics	Marvel Comics	transliterated	Romanization of Russian	superhero	superhero

Created by editor and plotter Stan Lee , scripter Don Rico , and artist Don Heck , the character first appeared in Tales of Suspense No. 52 -LRB- April 1964 -RRB- .	Tales of Suspense	Tales of Suspense	Stan Lee	Stan Lee	Don Rico	Don Rico	Don Heck	Don Heck
The character was first introduced as a Russian spy , an antagonist of the superhero Iron Man .	superhero	superhero	spy	espionage	Iron Man	Iron Man

She later defected to the United States , becoming an agent of the fictional spy agency S.H.I.E.L.D. , and a member of the superhero team the Avengers .	Avengers	Avengers (comics)	superhero	superhero	spy	espionage	defected	Defection
